description: MADFORWATER. WP4 Field pilots for the adaptation and integration of technologies. Task4.3 Operation and optimization of the field pilots. Wastewater treatment performances and Irrigation/treated waste is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Alma Mater Studiorum - Università di Bologna. This dataset contains MADFORWATER data relative to the wastewater (WW) treatment performances of the Domestic wastewater of Lamzar Agadir Morocco pilot. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Alma Mater Studiorum - Università di Bologna. Its tags are ING-IND/25 Impianti chimici. The repository dates the deposit 2020; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc_zero_1. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sanitation studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
